Hi Michael / Laura,

Thanks for turning this around. Legal at Solis has reviewed Redwood's latest MSA redlines and we're close — two quick asks before we execute:

- Can Redwood confirm who will be the executing signatory on your side and provide a brief statement of their signing authority? Our audit team requires either a CEO signature or a POA/corporate resolution if someone else is signing.
- Could you put the MSA + Order Form into a DocuSign envelope with the final clean copy and include the audit trail (time stamps + IP)? Also need the final clean PDF after countersign for our records.

I've attached our annotated MSA_Redlines_v3.pdf and the OrderForm we reviewed. If we can get the DocuSign link and a target signing window (48 hours), we can route on our side.

Best,
Eleanor

Solis Health

Hi all,

Thanks for the context. A few items from Legal before we proceed: 

- Signatory authority: If the intended Redwood signer is the CEO (expected), no additional POA required. If it's the EVP/GM level, we need either a corporate resolution or a notarized POA. Solis: can you confirm the exact signatory title we should expect? A one-line email from your GC or a scanned corporate resolution will suffice for our audit trail.
- Redlines: there's one clause on Section 7.2 that appears to have been reinserted from an earlier draft (liability carve). Please confirm Solis accepts the language in MSA_Redlines_v3.pdf page 12 (Karthik's redline). If not, we need a short note.
- DocuSign settings I recommend: Sequential signing; require email access + SMS code for Solis exec; set document retention to include the full audit report and completed PDF; enforce attachment of signatory ID only if required by Solis (let us know).

I've prepared a signer_authority_template.pdf you can use if needed — attaching here. Also drafted a short envelope template link for review: https://na2.docusign.net/envelope/XYZ-ENVELOPE-789 (draft - requires Michael's approval).

Once we have signatory confirmation, Laura can load the final clean copy and queue the envelope. If Solis needs a 48-hour signing window, we'll open the envelope on Monday 5/20 and set expiry to 72 hours.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
